answer: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships 2026–27 are open for first-year undergraduate students. The programme supports up to 5,000 students and provides a scholarship of up to ₹2 lakh over the duration of the degree. Current eligibility includes being a resident Indian citizen, having at least 60% in Class 12, being enrolled in the first year of a regular full-time undergraduate degree, having household income below ₹15 lakh, and completing the mandatory aptitude test. Please verify the latest eligibility and application details on the official Reliance Foundation website before applying.
